                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Operating context & accountability<\/strong>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Mistral deploys high-density AI infrastructure in colocation facilities, where partners operate the underlying critical plant. You will be Mistral\u2019s technical counterpart to providers, designers, commissioning specialists and internal IT and capacity teams. The position combines forward-looking design authority with hands-on technical investigation and portfolio reliability improvement. It requires depth in one core engineering discipline and the judgment to lead multidisciplinary decisions with specialist support.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Key responsibilities \u2014 design and technical standards<\/strong><\/p>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Own and continuously improve Mistral\u2019s technical design criteria and colocation requirements for new facilities, expansions and retrofits, including availability objectives, failure domains, maintainability and operational flexibility.<\/p><\/li>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Translate GPU platform roadmaps into measurable facility envelopes: IT load and transients, rack density, electrical topology, redundancy, cooling capacity, supply\/return temperatures, flow, pressure, water quality and monitoring.<\/p><\/li>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Review utility and MV\/LV arrangements, transformers, generators, UPS, switchgear, busway, protection coordination, earthing, power quality and metering for suitability under demanding AI loads.<\/p><\/li>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Review mechanical and controls architecture, including chilled-water and heat-rejection systems, pumps, control sequences, CDU integration, leak detection, filtration, water treatment and cooling recovery scenarios.<\/p><\/li>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Lead multidisciplinary reviews of single-line diagrams, P&IDs, sequences of operation, design calculations, capacity models, failure-mode studies and proposed deviations; document risks and decisions.<\/p><\/li>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Participate in site selection, technical due diligence, provider RFPs, design milestones and commercial technical schedules, challenging assumptions before they become delivery constraints.<\/p><\/li>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Define design review and exception processes that balance performance, resilience, deployment speed, efficiency, capital cost and long-term operability.<\/p><\/li><\/ul>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Key responsibilities \u2014 commissioning and delivery assurance<\/strong><\/p>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Partner with delivery and commissioning teams to define functional and integrated testing requirements, acceptance criteria, evidence packages and outstanding-defect management.<\/p><\/li>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Validate that electrical and cooling infrastructure can support the contracted AI load envelope under normal, maintenance and credible fault conditions.<\/p><\/li>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Review test scripts and results for loss of utility, UPS\/generator transitions, cooling component failures, controls faults, CDU interface events and staged restoration where applicable.<\/p><\/li>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Ensure operational handover includes accurate drawings, asset and interface registers, monitoring points, setpoints, maintenance constraints, emergency procedures and unresolved risk ownership.<\/p><\/li>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Support live-site changes and capacity upgrades with a disciplined review of impact, sequencing, rollback plans and operational readiness.<\/p><\/li><\/ul>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Key responsibilities \u2014 field reliability and root-cause analysis<\/strong><\/p>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Act as a technical escalation point for recurring or high-impact electrical, mechanical and controls incidents across operational colocation sites.<\/p><\/li>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Analyze alarms, BMS\/EPMS trends, event sequences, power-quality records, cooling telemetry, commissioning findings and maintenance evidence to distinguish symptoms from systemic causes.<\/p><\/li>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Lead or challenge technical root-cause investigations with colocation partners, including common-mode failures, protection miscoordination, thermal instability, control logic, hydraulic performance and hidden capacity limitations.<\/p><\/li>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Develop risk-ranked corrective actions and reliability improvement programs; validate effectiveness through evidence and post-change monitoring.<\/p><\/li>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Identify fleet-wide patterns and feed lessons learned into reference designs, acceptance tests, technical specifications and provider governance.<\/p><\/li>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Review maintenance and change proposals that create material exposure to compute availability, providing clear technical recommendations and escalation where required.<\/p><\/li><\/ul>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key responsibilities \u2014 collaboration and leadership<\/strong><\/p>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Work with IT hardware, network and platform teams to understand the operational consequences of rack-level and cluster-level failure domains.<\/p><\/li>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Develop reusable standards, technical playbooks and engineering knowledge sharing to support consistent decisions across a rapidly expanding portfolio.<\/p><\/li><\/ul>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            What success looks like<\/strong><\/p>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • New capacity is accepted against well-defined electrical, thermal and resilience criteria with transparent technical exceptions.<\/p><\/li>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Design risks are identified early, reducing late changes, stranded capacity and avoidable operational constraints.<\/p><\/li>

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Field experience produces measurable improvements to future designs and live-site operating resilience.<\/p><\/li><\/ul>

Job Description:

Bring your creative agency account experience in-house

Title: Sr. Associate, Client Solutions

Team: Network Solutions

Location: Remote; Canada or US, preferably around Chicago, Detroit, Atlanta, Raleigh, Tri-State area (New York, Connecticut, New Jersey or Philadelphia area), Washington DC or Boston

Why this Role Exists

You will own high-impact patient engagement campaigns that improve health outcomes, one patient at a time. As a Sr. Associate, Client Solutions, you’ll be a confident, client-facing campaign owner who drives day-to-day execution internally and externally. You bring a sharp eye for quality, a proactive mindset, and the experience to manage net new campaigns with growing independence—escalating when it counts, identifying process improvements, and helping elevate the team around you.

What You’ll Spend Your Time Doing

  • Campaign Development: Own and execute patient engagement campaigns from kickoff through launch and measurement, managing day-to-day coordination, campaign setup, quality control, and reporting with confidence. You’ll balance independent execution, critical thinking, and strong organization while building expertise in Phreesia products and campaign best practices. Relationship Building
  • Relationship Building: build strong relationships with clients and internal partners by serving as the day-to-day contact for owned campaigns, thoughtfully responding to client needs and questions, collaborating cross-functionally, and supporting the onboarding and development of Associates and new team members.
  • Strategic Projects: contribute to team and campaign success by identifying process improvements, sharing optimization recommendations, and providing informed perspectives on campaign strategy and executional approaches.
  • Mentorship: support the growth of junior team members and new hires by reinforcing foundational campaign processes and Client Solutions best practices while helping foster a collaborative, supportive team culture that reflects Phreesia’s Mission and Values.

What Makes You a Great Fit

You will be a great fit if you are:

  • A confident client communicator who builds trust, listens actively, and follows through reliably
  • A proactive problem-solver who can navigate ambiguity, think critically, and identify resourceful solutions
  • Organized and self-directed, with the ability to juggle multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment while adapting to changing needs
  • A collaborative team player who takes pride in supporting others, communicating openly, and elevating the team
  • Resilient and adaptable, maintaining a positive and solutions-oriented mindset through shifting priorities and feedback
  • Curious and growth-oriented, with a willingness to learn new tools, processes, and ways of working
  • Familiar with workflow and review tools such as Jira, Monday.com, Ziflow, or similar platforms, and able to quickly learn new systems

We Do Have a Few Requirements to Check:

  • Bachelor’s Degree required and 3+ years of account experience in a creative agency environment working with pharmaceutical brands
  • Demonstrated ability to manage client relationships and own campaign execution independently
  • Proficient in Microsoft tools and experienced implementing AI to support efficiency in your work
  • Ability and willingness to travel for occasional in-person team meetings (approximately 10% annually)

Where You’ll Work

This is a remote role, with the expectation that you’re based in EST or CST in Canada or the US.

Compensation & Rewards

Base salary: $80,000–$95,000 USD or CAD (depending on experience)

A comprehensive Total Rewards package designed to support your whole life — not just your work.

Who We Are:

At Phreesia, we’re looking for smart and passionate people to help drive our mission of creating a better, more engaging healthcare experience. We’re committed to helping healthcare organizations succeed in an ever-evolving landscape by transforming the way healthcare is delivered. Our SaaS platform digitizes appointment check-in and offers tools to engage patients, improve efficiency, optimize staffing, and enhance clinical care.

Phreesia cares about our employees by providing a diverse and dynamic work environment. We’re a five-time winner of Modern Healthcare Magazine’s Best Places to Work in Healthcare award and we’ve been recognized on the Bloomberg Gender Equality Index. We are dedicated to continuously improving our employee experience by launching new programs and initiatives. If you thrive in a culture of recognition, value inclusivity, professional development, and growth opportunities, Phreesia could be a great fit!

Top-rated Employee Benefits:

  • 100% Remote work + home office expense reimbursements

  • Competitive compensation

  • Flexible PTO + 8 company holidays

  • Monthly reimbursement for cell phone + internet + wellness

  • 100% Paid 12-week parental leave to our U.S. employees, as well as a generous parental benefit to our employees in Canada

  • Variety of insurance coverage for people (and pets!)

  • Continuing education and professional certification reimbursement

  • Opportunity to join an Employee Resource Group. Learn more here:

We strive to provide a diverse and inclusive environment and are an equal opportunity employer.

Underwriter (Real Estate Investment Lending)

Location: Remote throughout the US (CT, MA, NH preferred)

Schedule: Full-time, remote with opportunities for in-office collaboration at our West Hartford, CT or Portsmouth, NH offices

Compensation: Competitive Salary up to $120,000, Based on Experience

Make Smart Decisions. Help Investors Move Faster.

Great underwriting is about more than checking boxes. It's about understanding risk, making sound decisions, and finding ways to get good deals done.

That's what we're building at New Silver.

New Silver is a technology-enabled private lender focused exclusively on residential real estate investors. We help investors finance fix-and-flips, ground-up construction, and rental properties nationwide through one of the fastest and most convenient lending platforms in the industry.

As an Underwriter, you'll play a critical role in evaluating loan opportunities, structuring transactions, and ensuring we maintain strong credit standards as we grow. You'll work closely with our Loan Advisors, operations team, and leadership to make informed lending decisions while delivering the speed and certainty our borrowers expect.

We provide the technology, resources, and opportunity to make an impact. You bring the analytical skills, sound judgment, and ownership to help us grow responsibly.

What You'll Do

  • Underwrite residential investment loans, including fix-and-flip, ground-up construction, and DSCR rental property financing
  • Evaluate borrower creditworthiness, liquidity, experience, financial strength, and overall loan risk
  • Analyze property valuations, appraisals, budgets, and collateral to determine appropriate loan structures
  • Review borrower documentation, entity structures, and supporting financial information

Senior PVD Equipment Engineer

Company Overview

Vital Materials is a global technology organization with operations in over 20 countries, providing advanced materials, products, and solutions across markets including semiconductors, optics, consumer electronics, aerospace, automotive, and energy-related applications. The company is committed to enabling next-generation technologies through materials science and process innovation.

Job Summary

The Senior PVD Equipment Engineer is a senior technical role responsible for the design, development, build, and troubleshooting of physical vapor deposition (PVD) equipment, with a strong emphasis on magnetron sputtering systems. This position supports R&D, pilot-scale, and manufacturing operations, particularly for thin-film deposition of magnetic materials.

Responsibilities

  • Design and develop PVD equipment and subsystems with emphasis on magnetic sputtering and magnetron configurations.
  • Lead equipment architecture decisions including vacuum systems, gas and power delivery, magnetron design, and target assemblies.
  • Oversee build, installation, commissioning, and qualification of sputtering tools.
  • Diagnose and resolve equipment issues related to plasma stability, film uniformity, arcing, target wear, and magnetic field non-uniformity.
  • Support sputtering processes for magnetic and non-magnetic materials in R&D and manufacturing environments.
  • Collaborate with process, materials, and operations teams to optimize tool performance and reliability.
  • Develop and maintain equipment documentation and preventative maintenance procedures.
  • Identify and implement continuous improvement opportunities and equipment upgrades.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, or related field (advanced degree preferred).
  • Extensive hands-on experience designing, building, and troubleshooting magnetron sputtering tools.
  • Strong practical knowledge of PVD sputtering processes.
  • Direct experience with sputtering of magnetic materials strongly preferred.
  • Solid understanding of vacuum systems, plasma physics, RF/DC power supplies, and magnetic field design.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Ability to work independently and lead complex technical projects.

Additional Compensation & Benefits:

In addition to base pay, this role is eligible for:

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance coverage
  • 401(k) matching program
  • Paid Time Off (PTO), paid holidays, and sick leave

Note: Variable pay and benefits are subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable plan documents.

Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT) $62K-80K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $62,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist to develop, execute, and optimize digital marketing strategies that increase organic traffic, improve search rankings, generate qualified leads, and drive measurable business growth.

The ideal candidate has strong expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, paid social advertising, content optimization, marketing analytics, and automation. This is a hands-on role requiring someone who can independently manage campaigns, identify growth opportunities, and turn marketing data into actionable strategies.

You’ll take ownership of organic search performance, paid advertising, website optimization, and lead generation while exploring emerging opportunities in AI-powered search optimization (AEO/GEO).

Key Responsibilities

SEO Strategy & Optimization

  • Develop and execute SEO strategies to improve organic visibility, keyword rankings, and website traffic.
  • Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and search intent analysis.
  • Perform technical SEO audits, addressing indexing, crawling, site architecture, page speed, and mobile performance.
  • Optimize meta titles, descriptions, headings, internal linking, URLs, and structured data.
  • Execute ethical link-building strategies and monitor search algorithm updates.
  • Optimize content for traditional search engines and AI-powered search experiences (AEO/GEO).

Paid Advertising & Lead Generation

  • Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.
  • Manage advertising budgets to improve lead quality, Cost per Lead (CPL), and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).
  • Develop and optimize landing pages, lead capture forms, and conversion funnels.
  • Implement retargeting and remarketing campaigns.
  • Collaborate with sales teams to align marketing initiatives with revenue goals.

Content Marketing & Website Management

  • Develop SEO-driven content strategies aligned with business objectives.
  • Create and optimize website copy, blog articles, and landing pages.
  • Manage website updates through WordPress, Webflow, or similar CMS platforms.
  • Collaborate with designers, developers, and content creators to improve website performance and user experience.

Analytics, Reporting & Optimization

  • Monitor traffic, keyword rankings, conversions, and campaign performance using Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, and Google Tag Manager.
  • Build performance dashboards and provide actionable marketing reports.
  • Conduct A/B testing across landing pages, advertisements, and campaigns.
  • Analyze user behavior and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates.

Marketing Automation & CRM

  • Manage email marketing campaigns, lead nurturing sequences, and automated workflows.
  • Work with platforms such as HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, or ActiveCampaign.
  • Improve lead tracking, marketing attribution, and sales handoffs.
  • Maintain accurate campaign data and performance reporting.

  • Experience managing Google Ads and paid social media campaigns.
  • Familiarity with WordPress, Webflow, or other CMS platforms.
  • Understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO), landing pages, and lead generation funnels.
  • Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to translate data into actionable improvements.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple campaigns and meet deadlines.
  • Availability during U.S. Business Hours.

  • Experience with Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).

  • Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and technical website improvements.

  • Certifications in Google Ads, Google Analytics, HubSpot, or SEO.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You take ownership of marketing performance and focus on measurable results.

  • You can independently develop strategies, execute campaigns, and analyze performance.
  • You’re proactive about identifying growth opportunities and testing improvements.
  • You stay informed about search engine updates and emerging AI-powered marketing trends.
  • You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with remote teams.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing GA4, Google Search Console, and advertising dashboards to evaluate traffic, keyword rankings, and lead generation performance. You’ll investigate SEO opportunities, optimize paid campaigns, update website content, or improve landing page conversions.

You may also configure marketing automation workflows, analyze campaign results, and collaborate with sales or development teams to implement improvements.

In short: You’ll manage SEO, paid advertising, analytics, and marketing automation to generate qualified leads and drive measurable business growth.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Success in this role will be measured through:

  • Organic Traffic Growth: Increase qualified organic website traffic.
  • Keyword Rankings: Improve rankings for high-intent commercial keywords.
  • Lead Generation: Increase marketing-qualified leads from organic and paid channels.
  • Conversion Rate: Improve website and landing page conversions.
  • Cost per Lead (CPL): Optimize advertising spend and acquisition efficiency.
  • Return on Ad Spend (ROAS): Improve paid campaign profitability.
  • Technical SEO Health: Maintain indexing, crawling, and website performance.

Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT) $70K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

Objective of the role

Raidiam’s server-side team builds and runs the back-end services for Raidiam Connect, the ecosystem trust control system that digital identity ecosystems around the world rely on.

As a Junior Software Engineer you will work in the server-side team, primarily on our Java and Go services, as well as on infrastructure definition in terraform, and API definitions in OpenAPI, taking features and fixes from ticket to production with more experienced engineers around you to support you. The work is highly collaborative, the APIs we build are the contract other teams inside and outside of the company depend upon, so you will be in regular contact with product managers, UI developers and customer-facing colleagues, and with the people who operate the live environments. LLM-based coding assistants are a standard part of the team’s toolkit and will be part of yours.

Key responsibilities:

  • Push new features and bug fixes into the Directory’s server-side codebases in Java and Go, taking each piece of work through refinement, implementation, automated testing and code review, and supporting release to production.

  • Actively learn and adopt the technology and tools defined by the team, building genuine working fluency in both primary languages.

  • Use LLM-based coding assistants as a routine part of how you work and take full responsibility for everything you submit: understand it, test it, and be able to explain and defend it in review.

  • Write and maintain the automated tests, database migrations and API specification changes that go with your work, so that a change is finished when it is safely in production rather than when it compiles.

  • Learn quickly from the engineers around you and consistently step up when it is required, and as you find your feet, proactively support other team members and help them to be successful.

  • Contribute to code reviews as a junior engineer, to both help your learning process and because extra attention on our deliveries is always good.

  • Help keep the products you contribute to healthy: investigate defects raised against them, help diagnose problems in deployed environments, and escalate clearly and early when an issue is beyond your scope.

  • Take an active part in planning and estimation, and communicate progress, risks and blockers clearly.

Essential skills and qualifications

  • Experience writing server-side code in at least one of Go or Java in a professional, academic, open-source or substantial personal-project setting, together with the demonstrated appetite and aptitude to become productive in the other.

  • A working understanding of relational databases and SQL: able to read a schema, write basic queries and reason about a data model.

  • Comfortable with HTTP and REST APIs

  • Writes automated tests as a normal part of completing a piece of work, not as an afterthought.

  • Everyday fluency with version control (Git), and familiarity with code review and continuous integration.

  • Practical experience using LLM-based coding assistants, with the judgement to verify what they produce, the willingness to reject it when it is wrong, and the openness to be clear about what was generated.

  • Able to take a well-defined piece of work and see it through to production, asking for direction when it is needed, and communicating clearly with the wider team while work is in progress

  • A supportive and collaborative approach to working in a team: learns quickly from others, asks for help early, offers it readily, and both gives and receives code review well.

  • Clear written and spoken English, much of our work is documented, reviewed asynchronously and shared with external ecosystem participants and regulators. As we are a globally distributed company with fully remote working practices, communication is key.

Desirable

  • Exposure to AWS or similar cloud service.

  • Experience with Micronaut, Spring Boot or a comparable JVM framework.

  • Experience with infrastructure as code, particularly Terraform.

  • Familiarity with OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JSON Web Tokens, mutual TLS or X.509 / PKI concepts.

  • Experience with testing tools in the Java and Go ecosystems

What you can expect from us?

  • Salary: $75k -$90kper/year( Depending on experience)

  • Remote working

  • An opportunity to work alongside and learn from highly experienced industry professionals

  • A vibrant, exciting, and fast-paced environment fully supported by modern technology

  • Support for professional development and further studies for industry-standard qualifications with a dedicated training budget

About Raidiam

Raidiam is the global organisation at the forefront of data sharing technologies that are changing the world. Our mission is to empower every state, industry, and enterprise to benefit from open data exchanges by launching digital ecosystems based on trust. We believe in empowering everyone to share their data safely, securely and simply; in a trusted and consented way; creating the potential to be seamlessly connected to the products and services they need.

With customers in Brazil, UAE, Australia, New Zealand, and the UK, Raidiam has been the enabling force behind the world’s most significant data sharing developments, most notably the Open Finance and Open Insurance ecosystems in Brazil. We continue to be called upon by governments, regulators and businesses to provide advice and technical support to achieve their data sharing ambitions. We work from the centre – creating ecosystems with solid foundations to establish and nurture trust, the key to any successfuldata sharing. This makes us unique as the only provider in the market to operate from the core.

This is a remote role, and for this search we’re looking for someone who is currently based in Queensland, Australia.

Job Description Summary

As Sr Global Product Manager, Digital Solutions – Surgical & Procedural Care, you will shape the strategy, roadmap, and growth of digital solutions supporting perioperative workflows across pre-operative, intraoperative, and post-operative care. Working across executive leadership, product management, engineering, commercial, and functional teams, you will define portfolio-aligned priorities and deliver solutions that aim to improve clinical decision making, workflow efficiency, care coordination, and operational outcomes across the perioperative continuum. In partnership with customers, key opinion leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders, you will advance the vision of precision health.

Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

Job Description

You will align roadmaps with portfolio strategy, investment guardrails, and enterprise objectives. You will own the full product lifecycle and be accountable for the commercial success of perioperative digital solutions, driving customer adoption, recurring revenue growth, and measurable business outcomes. You will engage directly with customers, partners, and industry stakeholders to shape market direction and portfolio growth.

In this role you will:

  • Own strategy and execution for digital applications in the perioperative workflow, including analytics, surveillance, and decision-support solutions that aim to improve care-team efficiency and clinical outcomes.
  • Drive profitable growth of application domain through effective product strategy, execution, commercialization, and lifecycle management.
  • Own application strategy, business cases, and outcome-based roadmaps by translating customer needs, market opportunities, and competitive insights into differentiated products.
  • Own the commercial success of NPIs, including launch readiness, customer adoption, revenue growth, market penetration, and achievement of business case objectives.
  • Define product vision, value proposition, success metrics, and priorities, and lead execution across the product lifecycle from concept through delivery, commercialization, and adoption.
  • Develop and execute commercialization, go-to-market, and growth strategies in partnership with marketing, commercial, and service teams.
  • Influence pricing, packaging, business model, and investment decisions to maximize customer value, competitive differentiation, and long-term growth.
  • Build strong relationships with customers, Key Opinion Leaders, and partners, and serve as the domain expert and external spokesperson for application domain.
  • Drive adoption, retention, customer value realization, and recurring revenue growth across the installed base.

Critical Competencies & Skills:

  • Perioperative Clinical Workflow Expertise – Understanding of anesthesia, perioperative workflow, care-team coordination, and clinical decision-support needs across surgical and procedural care environments.
  • Strategic Product Leadership & Commercial Acumen – Ability to develop product strategies, business cases, and investment recommendations linked to customer and business outcomes.
  • Product Development & Execution – Experience leading products through the lifecycle from concept through commercialization, adoption, and growth.
  • Commercialization & Go-to-Market Execution – Ability to successfully launch and scale products through effective commercialization, customer adoption, and market penetration strategies.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership & Influence – Ability to align engineering, commercial, service, clinical, and executive stakeholders in a matrix organization.
  • Communication & Executive Presence – Ability to communicate effectively with customers, executives, engineers, and commercial teams through compelling storytelling, clear recommendations, and influence without authority.

Secondary Competencies & Skills:

  • Digital Health & Technology Expertise – Understanding of cloud and AI technologies, SaaS business models, interoperability standards, and healthcare IT workflows.
  • Financial & Analytical Acumen - Ability to evaluate investments, business performance, and product outcomes using financial, operational, and customer metrics.
  • Business Model Innovation & Pricing Strategy - Ability to identify growth opportunities and influence pricing, packaging, and business model decisions that maximize value.
  • Customer & Market Orientation – Ability to leverage customer insights, market intelligence, and competitive analysis to inform product decisions and drive adoption.
  • Continuous Learning & Technology Curiosity - Curiosity to explore emerging technologies, industry trends, and customer needs and translate insights into product innovation.
  • Willingness and ability to travel (~20%) domestically and internationally, including visits to customer sites, partner meetings, and industry conferences.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

  • NPI go-to-market success, including launch readiness, customer adoption, retention, and customer value realization.Product roadmap execution and business case performance, including achievement of roadmap commitments and business objectives.
  • Portfolio growth and strategic investment outcomes, including product growth, investment performance, and alignment to portfolio priorities.
  • Customer and partner outcomes, including customer satisfaction, references, and strategic partner engagement.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or higher Degree (or equivalency) in business, engineering, computer science, healthcare, or related field.
  • 6+ years of experience in product management, product development, commercialization, or business leadership within MedTech, digital health, healthcare technology, or a related industry.
  • Experience in healthcare, with relevant exposure to perioperative, surgical, anesthesia, procedural care, or adjacent acute-care clinical workflows.

We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership –always with unyielding integrity.

Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support.
